entities.name: the Rainbow Bridge (虹桥)
entities.what: A single-span arched timber bridge with no piers: its arch is a broad band of parallel curved timbers (the woven-beam arch, 编木拱) springing from both banks, and the deck rides on top of it, climbing from the south bank (picture lower left) over a high hump and coming down onto the north bank (upper right). Along the painted east (near) side runs a railing of X-braced panels between upright posts with a handrail; square beam ends stand out on the arch face, the biggest under the crown. The deck is packed with people and stalls; the big boat passes under the arch.

support_by.deck_c: bridge deck: 375 px west of the near edge
support_by.deck_w: bridge deck: 750 px west of the near edge

entities.vis: part: the south foot hidden behind the crowd at the south bank (v 1075-1290) and the big parasol (18660-18900, 880-1000); the north foot behind the big boat's mast lines (u 19950-20300, v 300-600); the west railing and the deck surface north of the crown hidden behind the crowd and the near railing
entities.src: 名画记: 虹桥 (pin 18); 名画记: 拥挤的桥面 (pin 20)
entities.note: LINES (scan px, west to east = south foot to north foot). deck_e = the painted east (near) edge of the deck, where the railing posts stand: the upper edge of the light outer beam of the arch (a band 16-20 px wide just under the railing), traced on the strokes every 2-3 px with a brightness profile across the band and checked on zoom-2/3 crops; points 18815-20000 measured, the end points est. Below the beam: a darker band of arch timbers, and the arch underside (arch_intrados_e) 60 px below deck_e on the flanks and 40 px at the crown (offsets checked on crops). deck_w = the west (far) edge: NOT PAINTED (hidden behind the crowd; no west railing is drawn). Estimated as deck_e shifted 750 px west at the same v (iso-height lines across this deck are level in the picture: see the bridge report). Evidence: where the deck crowd meets the water on the upstream side, its west boundary runs (18490, 395) -> (18300, 700), 700-800 px west of deck_e at the same v; north of the crown deck_w is behind the near railing and the arch (hidden). deck_c = the deck centre line (deck_e shifted 375 px west), est: the route's deck stretch for S3.road.main, leaving the south bank at (18435, 1090) and landing on the north bank at (19650, 396), the north half hidden behind the arch. FEET (base corners, ground H 0): se = deck_e's south foot, est (the edge is visible down to (18815, 1072), then hidden behind the heads of the people standing on the south bank, whose feet are at v ~1290; the foot is taken just below the last visible point; it could be up to ~200 px lower: see the report's alternatives). ne = deck_e's north foot at the foot of the near railing's capped end post (rail_end_n, a post with a pointed knob, top v 325, foot v ~396), where the deck edge flattens onto the north bank. sw and nw = deck_w's feet, est, at the same v as se and ne (sw among the shore-side stalls at the south bank, nw hidden behind the arch). Naming: the bridge runs south (lower left) to north (upper right); front = south; deck_e/deck_w replace the deck_s/deck_n named in the tile brief, because the deck's width lies across the picture (east-west), not up the silk. HEIGHTS (frame, 77 px/m): the deck profile [u, H] is in gen/map/S3/reports/bridge.md, H = (v of the ground line straight below - v of deck_e)/77, the ground line being the line through the two feet se and ne (the east face's foot on level ground: (18810, 1090) -> (20025, 396), slope -0.571). Highest deck H 5.44 m at u ~19330; the picture's highest deck point (19610, 280) is at H 4.65. support_by gives deck_e, deck_w and deck_c their own H profiles (bridge deck / bridge west edge / bridge centre line: the same heights at u, u-750 and u-375). NOT PAINTED / HIDDEN: the abutments and the arch's springings at the water (behind the south-bank crowd and behind the boat's mast lines at the north end); the west railing; the deck surface north of the crown. A woven arch needs abutments at both banks: parts of this entity, hidden. SCALE CUES (px): railing about 50 px from deck edge to handrail (rail_e_top, offset checked on crops), posts about 55-65 px apart on the south flank with an X-brace in each panel; outer deck beam 16-20 px; arch depth (deck edge to underside) 60 px on the flanks, 40 px at the crown; figures at the crown about 110 px from head to the deck edge; deck width (deck_e to deck_w) 750 px of u; deck_e from foot to foot 1215 px of u and 694 px of v. Beam ends: a framed block under the crown (u 19598-19645, v 300-332: a big transverse beam end, or a board; conf low) and a bracket-like block on the south flank (u 19104-19125, v 571-614). DEPTH DIRECTION: the foot-to-foot line se -> ne (18810, 1090) -> (20025, 396), slope -0.571, is the bridge's axis on the ground; the deck's cross direction is level in the picture. A square bridge (axis at right angles to the deck's width) needs a local receding direction of about dx 90 px/m here (51.25 / 0.571); with dx 31.6 (S4b's seam knot) the axis comes out 53 deg from east and the deck a parallelogram (report). Merge (the lead's note): the custom point list arch_intrados_e is now the line rib_e (same 16 points), because world() keeps lines and drops custom lists; the bridge kit takes its first and last points as the near-face springings at the water (support_by rib_e: water). Those two points are the ends of the traced intrados (18897, 1021) and (19977, 424); the springings themselves are hidden (behind the south-bank crowd, behind the mast lines), and the lead's study read them at about (18880, 1080) and (19960, 470). Merge: support_by normalised to the frame's keys: deck_e, deck_w and deck_c on "bridge deck" (one support with an H_profile_X, the lead's note; the bridge agent had proposed separate u-keyed supports "bridge west edge" and "bridge centre line"), rib_e on "water". Merge: a short balustered railing piece IS painted at the deck's west edge, just west of t6's youth S3.fig.youth_round_face_18643: two diagonal rails with balusters rising east from rail_w_piece_s (18600, 432) to rail_w_piece_n (18640, 384) (t5: 18603-18639, v 374-426; t6: (18597, 393) to (18637, 443); merge crop gen/map/S3/look/merge_west_rail.jpg). Read as the last visible panel of the west (far) railing, conf low: it runs parallel to the near railing about 60-100 px east of the estimated deck_w at the same v, which supports deck_w to within that. Second pass: the 'west railing piece' (18593-18640, 384-462; the custom points rail_w_piece_s/_n added at the merge, now removed) is not the deck's west railing but S3.prop.slatted_panel_18615: it stands 590-670 px west of deck_e, 50-130 px inside the water's edge, with a seated man between it and the water, and it falls to the east while the railings rise to the east. It is no evidence for deck_w. The water's edge on the upstream side of the south ramp is 696-776 px west of deck_e at every v from 400 to 965 (mean ~725), which supports deck_w = deck_e - 750 to within ~25-50 px. Second pass (middle): the 35 `bridge deck` entities west of u 18810 stay on the deck: the line where the south ramp's crowd meets the water runs 696-776 px west of deck_e from v 400 to v 965 and follows the arch's curve, so it is the deck's far edge, not a bank. FRAME: support_by deck_e on `bridge deck` (its own painted heights), deck_c on `bridge deck: 375 px west of the near edge` and deck_w on `bridge deck: 750 px west of the near edge`: each line point gets the height of the deck_e point at its own v, as the bridge agent derived (the supports are deck_e's [u, H] shifted west); rib_e on the water.

entities.name: end post (表木) at the bridge's south-east corner
entities.what: A tall, plain timber pole standing on the south bank east of the bridge's south foot, leaning very slightly east, with two bars crossed at its top like an X (a horizontal cross seen at a slant); a small dark knob or vane may sit above the cross. Its foot is hidden behind the tiled roof of the south-bank building.
entities.vis: part: the foot behind the tiled roof (u 18900-19150, v 1230 and below) and the people at v 1150-1290
entities.note: Pole about 10 px thick, traced from the cross (19008, 777) down past the mat-roofed stall under the arch to v ~1267, where the roof's ridge hides it (u 19019-19030 there). Foot est at the level of the feet of the people standing beside it (v ~1290). Painted height foot to cross ~513 px (6.7 m at 77 px/m; the painter draws near things large). Bars about 90 px long each. Finial: a small dark shape at (18998-19010, 700-725), read against the arch's outer beam behind it: conf low (both readings: a vane on the pole's tip, or a railing post of the bridge seen behind). It stands about 210 px east and 200 px lower than the deck's south-east foot, so it is set off from the bridge's corner toward the water's edge. The scholars name these poles 表木; only the two at the east corners are painted (the west ones would be hidden). Merge: a third post is painted, the far-side twin at the bridge's south end: S3.prop.bridge_end_post_far_19176 (pole at u ~19176 with an X at v 20-50, foot hidden behind the deck crowd).

entities.name: end post (表木) at the bridge's north-east corner
entities.what: A tall, plain timber pole standing on the north bank just east of the near railing's end post, with two bars crossed at its top like an X, right under the silk's top edge. A small block clasps the pole at about a third of its height above the ground; its foot is hidden behind the big boat's mast lines.
entities.vis: part: passes behind the north-bank table (u 19970-20053, v 237-300); the foot hidden behind the boat's mast lines below v ~370
entities.note: Pole about 8 px thick (edges at u 20044 and 20052), straight. Cross of two bars about 45 px long at v 27-55; a short stub rises to the silk's top edge (v ~20). Block (clamp or base) at (20046-20056, 296-327). Foot est at the level of the capped end post's foot beside it (v ~395). Painted height foot to cross ~355 px (4.6 m at 77 px/m), against ~513 px for the south-east post: the far post is painted smaller.

entities.name: the Rainbow Bridge set piece
entities.what: The arched timber bridge with its three painted end posts (表木): two at its east corners and one on the far side of its south end: one set piece to build (the deck as a walkable surface, the railing, the woven arch, the posts).
entities.note: The people, stalls and parasols on the deck are the tiles' (t5-t9, support "bridge deck"); the boat under the arch and its crew are river_e's.
